name: Beat The Bag
summary:
What sets Beat The Bag apart is its seamless integration with your physical punching bag.  No other fitness game provides this level of immersion, combining the physicality of real-world training with the thrill of virtual combat.

But it’s not just about landing punches—Beat The Bag is all about mastering the art of defense. 🛡️ Your opponent is fast and relentless, throwing combinations that will test your agility and reaction time. The key to victory? Dodge, weave, and outmaneuver every strike they send
